WITH product_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.production_type_code,
        AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count,
        CAST(COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) /
            NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0) AS order_item_share
    FROM Products p
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code
), type_stats AS (
    SELECT
        pc.product_type_description,
        AVG(ps.avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        AVG(ps.order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
        AVG(ps.order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
    FROM Product_Categories pc
    JOIN product_stats ps ON ps.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
    GROUP BY pc.production_type_description
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
    AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
FROM type_stats;
